source: due2-native: a refined action named by a skolem IRI (follow-up review F03, #122)
notes: Authored for due2; no origin result. A refined action is recognised by its rdf:value, not by its node kind (decisions/0034, amendment of 2026-10-25): the action node here is the skolem IRI .well-known/genid/a1, as a tool that skolemises blank nodes writes it (RDF 1.1 Concepts §3.5), and its rdf:value odrl:print is the action. The node is typed odrl:Action, as in the follow-up review's F03 input (docs/briefings/due2-review-2026-10-25.md). Before the amendment, both checkers read rdf:value only on a blank node: they took the skolem IRI itself as the action, and checked it, as a typed action, for an odrl:includedIn it does not have. w3c-fs-c1 and w3c-fs-c2 keep the W3C CG's names for the same form. Only the due2 profile is selected: due2-core binds odrl:dateTime to due2:actionTime, which is request.at (due2-profiles.md §3).

expected.why: The action is genid/a1's rdf:value, odrl:print, which the request names, and its refinement holds: 1 March is before 1 April. The target and assignee match, so ex:print applies and has no duties: Permit.
The refinement narrows the action to printing before 1 April, and 15 April is not before it, so the action part is F and ex:print does not apply. No rule applies: NotApplicable.
